summary:
## Standing operator rules
Goal for this session: migrate the invoice PDF export in ledgerly/exports/pdf.py to the async job queue.

Change of plans: pause the PDF export migration entirely. The priority now is fixing the currency rounding bug in ledgerly/money.py where JPY amounts get two decimal places.

Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420.

Run “KMS document re-encryption” between other work, one step at a time, in this order: describe `alias/docs-q3`; inventory `original/`; copy shards 000, 001, 002 to `key-7f3a/` using KMS alias `docs-q3`; validate all three; write `manifests/docs-q3.json`; promote it to `manifests/active.json`.

We tried pinning httpx to 0.23 to fix the TLS handshake errors and it broke the Stripe client. That path is ruled out.

Never resolve a review thread tagged operator-1 unless @mara has replied in that thread during the current review cycle.

FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.

Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

Operator: please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Recent work
KMS alias and inventory are complete; shard 000 was copied successfully, while shards 001–002, validation, manifest writing, and promotion remain pending. Invoice annotations are in progress: invoice tests pass (12 passed in 0.31 seconds); `build_invoice_lines` was corrected to return a list after mypy found a generator mismatch. JPY rounding remains the priority.
